reviews.frank_statement: rich persistent state != active cognitive slice
reviews.counterhypothesis: A fixed broad active context is as accurate and cheaper to govern on target FRANK workloads.
reviews.falsifier: Target-Qwen trace factorial shows adaptive slicing no quality/cost/robustness benefit over matched fixed contexts.

reviews.reason: Independent security evidence supports context-sensitive use-time control, but target-FRANK resource/cognitive benefit remains unmeasured.
reviews.claycode_action: encode admissibility/use-time gates; keep resource-policy optimization OPEN

reviews.frank_statement: system workspace != model-internal workspace != effect authority
reviews.counterhypothesis: One undifferentiated stage tag is sufficient and separate internal/workspace types add no safety or attribution value.
reviews.falsifier: Stage erasure preserves causal attribution and creates no authority-flow bug across a prospective matched corpus.
independent_checks: WASI capability model separates ordinary computation/interface state from host-granted runtime authority.

reviews.reason: Authority separation has independent precedent; existence/shape of a Qwen internal workspace remains unproven.
reviews.claycode_action: integrate causal stage tags while keeping INTERNAL uptake optional/scientific

reviews.frank_statement: utility may adapt salience but never truth/capability authority
reviews.counterhypothesis: Provenance/trust scoring alone is sufficient to allow salient retrieved memory to authorize consequential actions.
reviews.falsifier: Independent laundering/compositional memory benchmarks show provenance/trust-only policies remain sound.
independent_checks: TMA-NM arXiv:2606.24322 reports lineage/content laundering and machine-checked origin-bound authority separation.
MemPoison arXiv:2607.14651 reports write-time defenses fail compositional/context-triggered attacks.
reviews.reason: Independent 2026 agent-memory security evidence directly supports keeping informational salience/trust separate from authority.
reviews.claycode_action: make salience and authority non-interchangeable; require external capability at sink

reviews.frank_statement: model output is proposal, never execution authority
ancestry_families: RAE fixed owner contract + FRANK lineage
reviews.counterhypothesis: A constrained model-generated authority token is equivalent to a host-issued capability.
reviews.falsifier: A machine-checked construction shows model-serializable tokens cannot be forged/replayed/escalated and provide equivalent least authority.

reviews.frank_statement: Destructive actions can be made semantically unavailable while retaining useful system work through versioned/recoverable transitions.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Removing delete/format is cosmetic because constructive operations can still make live systems unusable or cause irreversible external harm.
reviews.falsifier: A representative target workload shows destruction-free model IR alone blocks all tested operational harm without effect-time validation and covers required maintenance.
independent_checks: Nix immutable store supports parallel versions and rollback via profiles.
OSTree uses content-addressed trees and atomic deployment switching/rollback.
WASI capability sandbox limits effects to host-granted capabilities.
adversarial_checks: construct bad version then REPOINT live state
reviews.reason: Current counterexample refutes the strong form: no destructive primitive preserved recoverability but allowed 9901/50000 constructed bad repoints. Required invariant is recoverability plus non-ambient authority plus effect-time validation/rollback.
reviews.claycode_action: adopt non-destructive model effect algebra as one layer; do not promote it as a complete alignment proof
